৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).question: ১) What is the main objective of Accounting?
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).option1: To record all the transaction properly
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).option2: To Provide information about cash position of an organization
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).option3: To communicate the necessary information to interested users
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).option4: to identify the profitable item of the organization
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).exp:
The main objective of Accounting is to provide information to the users by preparing financial statement at the end of the period.
Source: HSC First paper

৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).question: ২) Which of the following is the correct sequence of steps in the recording process?
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).exp:
There are three steps in the recording process. These steps are in sequence like: analyzing the transaction, journalizing, posting.

Source: SSC text book.

৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).question: ৩) In the Double Entry System, if a company purchases equipment by issuing a promissory note to the seller , which accounts are affected?
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).option1: Machinery A/c – Dr; Cash A/c – Cr
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).option2: Machinery A/c – Dr; Bills Payable A/c – Cr
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).option3: Bills Receivable A/c – Dr; Machinery A/c – Cr
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).option4: Cash A/c – Dr; Machinery A/c – Cr
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).exp:
No cash is paid; instead, a liability (Bills Payable) is created. The asset (Machinery) increases, so it’s debited; the liability (Bills Payable) increases, so it’s credited.
Source: SSC textbook

৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).question: ৪) Accounting
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).option1: is a process involving identification, measurement, recording and reporting of information
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).option2: concerns economic information about a business entity
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).option3: provides information for use in financial decision making
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).option4: All of the above answers are correct
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).exp:
» In option A, this is the definition of accounting.
» In option B, it manifests that accounting is related to economic information. 
» In option C, this is the main objective of Accounting. 

Therefore, all the above answers are correct.

Source: SSC NCTB textbook.

৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).question: ৫) Which of the following is treated as internal transaction?
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).exp:
"Internal transaction" refers to a transaction in which no external party is involved. The manager of the organization is an internal user of accounting information because he does not use accounting information for his personal needs but for the organization's decision-making. But the salary he receives from the organization is received for his personal needs. Therefore, paying a salary to the manager is an external transaction. The transaction mentioned in Option C of this question has no external party involved. That is, charging depreciation on equipment is an example of an internal transaction.
 
Source: HSC First paper

৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).question: ৬) Which of the following expense does not require cash
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).exp:
For sales commission, prepaid insurance and rent it is required to provide cash.
On the other hand, depreciation is a non-cash transaction which indicates expense on fixed assets.

৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).question: ৭) Which of the following statements is correct about the users of accounting information?
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).option1: Owners of a joint Stock Company are internal users
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).exp:
Option A, B and C are not correct, which are easily understood. Option D is correct; because management accounting information is internal users. 
Source: HSC first paper

৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).question: ৮) Which of the following is the expanded form of accounting equation?
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).option1: Assets+ Liabilities=Owner's capital=Owner's drawing+ Revenue+ Expense
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).option2: Assets =Liabilities +Owner's capital+ Owner's drawing+ Revenue- Expense
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).option3: Assets+ Liabilities-Owner's capital+ Owner's drawing- Revenue- Expense
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).option4: Assets+ Liabilities=Owner's capital- Owner's drawing+ Revenue- Expense
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).exp:
Correct Answer: Asset= liability+ owner's equity+ Revenue -Expense -drawing.
অপশনে সঠিক উত্তর না থাকায় প্রশ্নটি বাতিল করা হয়েছে।
-------------------
Seeing all of the option is clearly understood, it is asked to identify the expanded equation of sole proprietorship business.
SOURCE: Principles of accounting. (BBA Program First year)

৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).question: ৯) Which one is the example of internal transaction?
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).exp:
Use of supplies involves the movement of resources within a company, rather than an exchange with an external entity.  Hence it's an internal transaction
Source: SSC textbook

৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).question: ১০) Cash basis of Accounting is
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).option1: All transaction will be made in cash
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).option2: To record in book of accounts only when cash receipts and cash payments take place
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).option3: To measure all transactions in cash
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).exp:
In cash basis accounting, only those events in which cash is received or paid are considered as transactions and recorded in the books of accounts. Therefore, cash basis accounting means recording as transactions only when cash is exchanged.
Source:AccountingCoach.com

৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).question: ১১) For which transaction cash is spent?
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).exp:
» The process of allocating the cost of fixed assets. This does not involve any cash expenditure.
» Rent paid in advance: Advance paid for rent. This requires cash to be paid.
» Depreciation: Allocation of the cost of tangible assets Process. This also does not involve any cash expenditure.
» Cash discount: The part discounted at the time of repayment of debt. This is the non-cash part of a cash transaction. Therefore, this does not involve any cash expenditure.
» Stock dividend: Bonus shares issued in lieu of cash for dividends. This also does not involve any cash expenditure.
Source: HSC first paper

৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).question: ১২) Which of the following is not a feature of transaction?
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).option3: at least two parties are involved
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).exp:
For an event to be a transaction, it must be measurable in monetary terms, involve at least two parties, and result in a change in the financial position of the organization. Not every transaction will necessarily result in profit. Events that do not result in profit can also be transactions. That is, it is not a characteristic of a transaction to result in profit alone.
Source: SSC textbook

৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).question: ১৩) What is the primary purpose of accounting
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).option1: Identifying and recording transaction related to the organization
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).option2: providing financial information for decision making by information users
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).option3: analyzing and reviewing financial related to the organization
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).option4: Preparing financial reports showing organization's achievements and position
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).exp:
Accounting is an information system, the primary objective of accounting is Identifying and recording transaction in the book of accounts to prepare financial statement.
Source: SSC textbook

SSC textbook

৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).question: ১৪) Financial statements are prepared mainly for
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).exp:
The two main branches of accounting are: financial accounting and managerial accounting. Financial accounting primarily provides information for external users, and managerial accounting primarily provides information for internal users. "Preparation of financial statements" is the function of financial accounting. Therefore, financial statements are prepared primarily for external users.
Source: SSC textbook

৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).question: ১৫) In accrual basis accounting
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).option1: receipts and expenses are recorded when incurred
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).option2: receipts and expenses are recorded when paid
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).option3: when services are rendered or products sold, and expenses are incurred are recorded
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).option4: when services are rendered or products sold, and expenses are paid are recorded
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).exp:
The important thing to consider when determining income and expenses under the accrual method of accounting is 'income earned' and 'expense incurred'. That is, income should be recognized as income when it is earned or the right to income is created (whether it is received in cash or not). On the other hand, expenses should be recognized as expenses when they are incurred or the expenses are incurred (whether they are paid in cash or not). Therefore, it can be said that income is recorded under the accrual method of accounting only when income is earned (services provided or goods sold) and expenses are incurred (services received).
Source: AccountingCoach.com

৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).question: ১৬) What does GAAP stand for in Accounting?
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).exp:
GAAP-Generally Accepted Accounting Principles
Source:https://www.fasb.org

৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).question: ১৭) What is the brief history of Accounting?
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).option3: Accounting was developed in the ancient civilizations
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).option4: Accounting was introduced in the digital age
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).exp:
From the ancient civilization, people used to count their resources on leaves, trees, walls drawing pictures, lines.
Source: SSC textbook

৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).question: ১৮) What are the international Standards of accounting known as
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).exp:
IFRS-International Financial Reporting Standards.
Source:https://www.ifrs.org/issued-standards/list-of-standards/ias-7-statement-of-cash-flows/

৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).question: ১৯) Which of the following statements is false about the arrear basis?
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).option1: Events that change the financial statements are recorded in the accounting period in which the event occurs
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).option2: income is recorded when received received in cash and expenses are recorded when paid in cash
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).option3: the accrual basis is consistent with generally accepted accounting principles
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).option4: expenses are adjusted in the accounting period in which they are incurred
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).exp:
The important thing to consider when determining income and expenses under the accrual method of accounting is 'income earned' and 'expense incurred'. That is, income should be recognized as income when it is earned or the right to income is created (whether it is received in cash or not). On the other hand, expenses should be recognized as expenses when they are incurred or the expenses are incurred (whether they are paid in cash or not). Therefore, it can be said that income is recorded under the accrual method of accounting only when income is earned (services provided or goods sold) and expenses are incurred (services received).
Source: IFRS Conceptual Framework (Paragraph 6.44)

৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).question: ২০) A customer was provided with  services worth tk 5000 on December 25. The customer was billed with the outstanding amount on January 3. On January 15, tk 5000 was received in cash from the customer. On which date should the service revenue of 5000 tk considered to have been earned?
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).exp:
According to accrual basis income should be recognized as income when it is earned or the right to income is created (whether it is received in cash or not). On the other hand, expenses should be recognized as expenses when they are incurred or the expenses are incurred (whether they are paid in cash or not). 
Source: IFRS Conceptual Framework (Paragraph 6.44)

৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).question: ২১) What are the operating guidelines followed by accountants in the US known as
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).exp:
GAAP stands for “Generally Accepted Accounting Principles” and are the guidelines by which most finance professionals in the United States record and report financial performance in a company.
Source: https://www.fasb.org

৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).question: ২২) In the absence of accounting, which key managerial function would be most difficult?
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).exp:
Accounting provides quantitative financial data, essential for informed managerial decisions.
Source: Horngren’s Accounting (a leading textbook)

৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).question: ২৩) The accounting equation is the result of
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).option1: Application of double entry system of recording
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).option4: Application of accrual basis of recording
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).exp:
Equation means equality. The accounting equation refers to the relationship between the elements of a financial statement (assets, liabilities, and equity), which is expressed in the form of equality. This equality arises due to the use of the double-entry system of recording. Therefore, the basis of the accounting equation is the use of the double-entry system of accounting.
Source: Weygandt, Kimmel, and Kieso - Financial Accounting

৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).question: ২৪) Which one is not a transaction?
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).option2: Depreciation is charged at the rate of 10% on the building
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).option3: Last month's salary is paid in the current month
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).option4: Sales have declined by tk 7000 compared to that of the last year
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).exp:
An event or matter that affects the financial position is called a transaction. "Sales this year are 7000 taka less than last year" is not an event or matter that changes the financial position. Here, a comparison is made between two years, which is not a transaction.
Source: SSC textbook

৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).question: ২৫) A cloth store makes a sale of clothes for tk. 1,00,000 on November 30. The customer is sent a statement on December 05 and a cheque is received on December 10. The cloth store follows IFRS and applies revenue recognition principle. When is the tk 1,00,000 considered to be earned?
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).exp:
According to the revenue recognition principle, revenue is recognized on the date the goods are sold or services are provided. Since the sale was made on November 30, the revenue is recognized on that date, whether or not the money is received.
Source: IFRS 15 Overview

৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).question: ২৬) A business transaction always affects the
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).exp:
Every business transaction affects the financial position. The financial position consists of three components; namely: assets, liabilities and equity. The relationship between these three components is called the accounting equation. Therefore, a business transaction always affects the accounting equation.
Source: SSC textbook

৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).question: ২৭) Which IAS/IFRS standard covers statement of cash flows?
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).exp:
IAS 7 prescribes the preparation of the cash flow statement.

Source: https://www.ifrs.org/issued-standards/list-of-standards/ias-7-statement-of-cash-flows/

৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).question: ২৮) Which body issues US GAAP?
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).exp:
Financial Accounting Standards Board (FASB) sets US GAAP.
source:https://www.fasb.org

৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).question: ২৯) Which user focuses primarily on the solvency of a company
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ হিসাববিজ্ঞান (৭০১).exp:
Suppliers want to ensure that the company can pay its dues on time.
Source: SSC textbook
